subject: Schedule behaviour when capacity drops but all servers are currently busy

messages.author: 828433663124ca03
messages.subject: Schedule behaviour when capacity drops but all servers are currently busy
parts:
Assuming I go from 4 to 3 servers at time = 50 with the schedule tool, but all servers are occupied at that time, does a server complete the task before the capacity decreases, or does service stop immediately with the entity thrown back to the queue?

I've been trying to think through a way to test this directly in a sim, but haven't been able to wrap my head around it unfortunately.  Input appreciated.

Cheers,

L

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Schedule behaviour when capacity drops but all servers are currently busy
parts:
Two cases depending on the resource:

* If `preemptive=FALSE` (by default in `add_resource`), the server continues serving the tasks. Think about a doctor attending a patient, and then his/her turn ends.
* If `preemptive=TRUE`, the server postpones tasks in order to meet the new capacity and until there is room again for them. Think about a processor with 4 cores occupied, and then you turn off 2 cores.
